entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to make a return for my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's David Miller, order number VF77819.

Thank you, David. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th, which was 41 days ago. To understand how I can best help, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not a fault, it just... it's not what I expected. Honestly, I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I feel terrible about this, but I did try to return it much earlier.
I understand completely. You mentioned you tried to return it earlier? Can you tell me more about that?
Yes, it was on the 9th day after I got it. I went to your website, but there was a major website error. The whole return portal seemed to be completely down.
I see. So you're saying the system was down when you tried to process the return online?

Exactly. The whole system was down. I tried for an hour. I took a screenshot of the error page because I was worried this would happen. I couldn't print the return label or get any kind of confirmation. It was very frustrating.

David, thank you for that information. Let me check our system logs for that date... One moment... Yes, you are absolutely right. I can see a record of a known outage with our return portal on that day. I am so sorry you were affected by that; it's completely our fault.

Let me just review the return policy for you... Okay, I'm looking here and our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you were prevented from returning within the first few days due to our technical issue, and you are well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely approve this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, wow. Really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried. This is a huge help.

Of course. It was our mistake, and I'm happy to make it right. I am sending the return instructions and a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Thank you again. I really appreciate your understanding.
You're very welcome, David. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
